source: ClimaClue worldwide 0.1° areas (CHELSA V2.1 1981–2010; ERA5-Land 1981–2010 for dew point and snow; CRU CL 2.0 about 1961–1990 for sunshine). Area averages as stored in the tiles; null = missing.
fields: rh/rl: record high/low °C at the nearest weather station within 75 km (NOAA GHCN-Daily); cold/warm: coolest/warmest month mean °C; hi: warmest month average day high; lo: coldest month average night low; rain: mm a year; dry: months under 30 mm; sun: hours a year; wind: mean m/s; hum: mean relative humidity %; dew: muggiest month dew point °C; snow: fresh snow cm a year (1 mm water ≈ 1 cm); sea: km to the sea
